description: We are InfotronX, a robotics team passionate about technology, programming, engineering, and innovation. We enjoy building robots, solving problems, and working together. We are looking for creative, motivated people interested in robotics, coding, electronics, and teamwork. Join us and turn ideas into reality!
summary: Nova Odyssey is an interactive space exploration game that allows players to experience the challenges of planning and carrying out a space mission. Players explore destinations such as the Moon, Mars, and Saturn, select scientific instruments, assemble rockets, and monitor mission telemetry. The main objective is to successfully travel to the Moon, explore its surface, discover interesting geological features, and collect lunar fragments for scientific research. The project combines space science, technology, and problem-solving to help players understand how real space missions work. By simulating rocket assembly, spacecraft navigation, landing procedures, and scientific exploration, Nova Odyssey makes space exploration more engaging and educational. It encourages curiosity about our Solar System and demonstrates the importance of scientific research in understanding other worlds.
details:
Nova Odyssey is an interactive space exploration game designed to make learning about space missions more engaging and accessible. The game allows players to explore different celestial destinations, including the Moon, Mars, and Saturn. Players can assemble rockets, prepare space missions, monitor mission telemetry, navigate through space, and explore the lunar surface while collecting fragments for scientific research.
The main benefit of the project is that it combines education with interactive gameplay. It helps users understand the complexity of space exploration, discover interesting facts about celestial bodies, and develop problem-solving, critical-thinking, and scientific reasoning skills. Our intended impact is to inspire curiosity about astronomy and space science, especially among young people, and encourage interest in future space exploration.
Nova Odyssey was developed using HTML, CSS, and Three.js. HTML was used to structure the project, CSS to create its visual design and interface, and Three.js to build interactive 3D space environments and visual elements. These technologies helped us create an immersive browser-based experience.
The creative aspect of our project is the combination of space science, 3D visualization, and interactive gameplay. During development, we considered educational value, scientific accuracy, user experience, accessibility, and visual quality. Our goal is to transform complex space-related concepts into an enjoyable learning experience that encourages users to discover more about the universe.
